slides.slide_title: Introduce prefixes: un- re- pre- dis-
slides.teacher_cue: New morphological tool — prefixes. A prefix is a chunk added to the FRONT of a word that changes its meaning. un- = not or reverse: unhappy, unlock, undo. re- = again: replay, rewrite, reread. pre- = before: preview, preschool, predict. dis- = not or away: dislike, discover, disagree. Key decoding strategy: if a word looks long and hard, check if it starts with a known prefix — strip it off and decode the base word first.
slides.expected_response: Students identify prefixes, strip them, decode the base, then reassemble the full word.
slides.correction_move: Model the strategy: unlock → un + lock. Preview → pre + view. Dislike → dis + like. Students practice stripping prefixes and decoding the base word, then recombining.
slides.observation_note: Watch for students trying to decode the whole word as a single unit rather than using the prefix strategy.

slides.teacher_cue: Say unlock. un- = not/reverse, lock = the base. Reveal and blend by morpheme.
slides.expected_response: Students say unlock orally and connect meaning before blending.
slides.correction_move: Model unlock orally again, reveal and blend.
slides.observation_note: Watch for un- as a unit and lock as a known word.

slides.teacher_cue: Say reread — to read again. re- = again, read = the base. Reveal and blend.
slides.expected_response: Students say reread orally and connect meaning before blending.
slides.correction_move: Model reread orally again, reveal and blend.
slides.observation_note: Watch for re- as a unit and the long /iː/ in both re- and read.

slides.teacher_cue: Say preview — to see before. pre- = before, view = the base. Reveal and blend.
slides.expected_response: Students say preview orally and connect meaning before blending.
slides.correction_move: Model preview orally again, reveal and blend.
slides.observation_note: Watch for pre- as a unit.

slides.expected_response: Students say dislike orally and connect meaning before blending.
slides.correction_move: Model dislike orally again, reveal and blend.
slides.observation_note: Watch for dis- as a unit and CVCe pattern in like.
